data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-accident-years deterioration of $36.2m (adverse development) in 2019. The deterioration was driven principally by International Financial Lines and International Property & Casualty accounts, partly offset by favourable development in Marine, Crisis Management, Energy Property and Wholesale Property & Casualty. Overall the movement represents a small strengthening relative to opening gross claims outstanding (approximately 0.6%).
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $36.2m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure ($36.2m) is taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative (Note 5). The note gives the $36.2m figure but does not explicitly label it 'gross' versus 'net of reinsurance' in the sentence; the note is the primary movement note and is used here as the authoritative prior year movement. The technical reserves reconciliation contains movement lines that mix current-year changes and are not used. The 2018 note shows an RITC item (RITC from S1209) which can distort multi-year comparisons; the claims triangle was used as a cross-check. All amounts are in the statement currency (USD).
